description: This file defines functions and types related to managing session files, including listing session files for an agent, constructing session paths, normalizing and extracting session text, and building session file entries with metadata.

classes.name: SessionFileEntry
classes.description: Type representing a session file with metadata including path, modification time, size, hash, content, and line mapping.

methods.name: listSessionFilesForAgent
methods.description: Lists session transcript files for a given agent ID, filtering by specific filename pattern.

methods.name: sessionPathForFile
methods.description: Generates a session path string from an absolute file path.

methods.name: extractSessionText
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes session text from a string or array of text blocks.

methods.name: buildSessionEntry
methods.description: Builds a session file entry object with metadata and processed content from a file path.
